01.name: The Creative
01.description: A colossal sun engine above a mountain monastery, radiant heliostat petals unfolding like a mechanical lotus, white cranes crossing a gold sky, young engineers in linen robes tuning copper mirrors, pure upward force, creation as clean solar fire.

02.name: The Receptive
02.description: Vast terraced earth gardens after rain, dark rich soil glowing with seedlings, quiet solar lanterns tucked among furrows, a low earthen sanctuary open to the horizon, fertile patience and deep receiving ground.

03.name: Difficulty at the Beginning
03.description: Tangled young vines climbing a half-built greenhouse frame during a spring storm, apprentices securing bamboo supports, little lamps still burning through rain, fragile sprouts pushing through cracked clay, chaotic birth of a new eco-settlement.

04.name: Youthful Folly
04.description: A novice standing before a water-powered teaching machine, wrong levers pulled, little fountains misfiring into sunlight, patient elder silhouette nearby, mountain classroom full of seedlings and diagrams etched into clay tablets, innocence learning through comic confusion.

05.name: Waiting
05.description: Silent monks seated beneath transparent rain collectors, clouds gathering above solar roofs, bowls placed for first drops, suspended aqueducts glowing faintly, an atmosphere of readiness without haste.

06.name: Conflict
06.description: Two irrigation councils facing each other across a narrow canal, sunlight glinting on water gates, red and blue prayer flags pulled tight by wind, peaceful architecture under tension, a storm line over the valley.

07.name: The Army
07.description: Rows of solar field stewards marching through terraced farms with seed satchels, repair tools, and folded shade sails, disciplined but nonviolent, a command tower made of bamboo and brass overlooking green abundance.

08.name: Holding Together
08.description: Villagers linking floating garden platforms into a radiant wetland mandala, ropes, lily pads, solar lamps, shared hands, community reflected in still water, unity as ecology and craft.

09.name: Small Taming
09.description: A tiny rooftop wind vane and delicate shade cloth restraining an overbright sunbeam above fragile herbs, careful micro-adjustments, brass clips, patient hands, power guided by small acts.

10.name: Treading
10.description: A narrow glass walkway crossing above a sleeping solar furnace, bare feet on translucent panels, golden light below like contained lightning, white-robed figure moving with exquisite care, danger answered by grace.

11.name: Peace
11.description: A valley where old temples, solar arrays, rice terraces, and wildflower roofs blend into one serene ecosystem, warm air, clear streams, children releasing seed kites, heaven and earth in easy conversation.

12.name: Standstill
12.description: A dry greenhouse locked in noon glare, still turbines, closed lotus panels, dust on brass instruments, a lone caretaker waiting beside an empty cistern, beauty paused and breath held.

13.name: Fellowship
13.description: An open-air solar feast on a monastery roof, strangers sharing bowls beside glowing planters, lantern drones hovering like fireflies, mountain horizon wide and blue, fellowship as warmth and shared labor.

14.name: Great Possession
14.description: A treasury of seeds, sunlight, and rainwater instead of gold, crystal seed vaults, full cisterns, mirrors pouring light into underground gardens, abundance glowing but carefully tended.

15.name: Modesty
15.description: A small moss-covered hut beneath gigantic solar towers, humble clay bowls, simple sandals, a single apricot tree in bloom, quiet proportion between human scale and cosmic energy.

16.name: Enthusiasm
16.description: Festival drums powered by foot pedals in a sunlit courtyard, streamers, seed fireworks made of drifting petals, dancers under bright solar canopies, joy as renewable motion.

17.name: Following
17.description: A line of pilgrims following glowing irrigation channels down a mountainside at dusk, little solar beads lighting the path, water leading people gently through terraces and orchards.

18.name: Work on What Has Been Spoiled
18.description: Apprentices restoring a collapsed greenhouse overrun by weeds, cracked solar glass removed, compost steaming, old mistakes becoming fertile soil, golden repair light through broken panels.

19.name: Approach
19.description: A radiant elder descending terraced stairs toward a village, carrying a basket of seedlings and small copper tools, children and farmers looking up, dawn expanding over the valley, blessing arriving with practical help.

20.name: Contemplation
20.description: A high observation pavilion with circular sun lenses, an oracle gazing over wind patterns in fields below, cloud shadows moving like slow thoughts, vast stillness, seeing before acting.

21.name: Biting Through
21.description: A solar-powered cutting wheel slicing through a rusted water gate jammed with roots, sparks and droplets in the air, decisive repair, clean force freeing blocked flow.

22.name: Grace
22.description: An artful greenhouse at twilight, stained-glass solar cells casting jewel colors over orchids and white stone, delicate copper filigree, beauty as clarity and ritual ornament.

23.name: Splitting Apart
23.description: A cliffside terrace crumbling in slow motion, roots exposed, solar tiles sliding, caretakers watching from a safe bridge, sunset copper and shadow, the necessary fall of unstable structures.

24.name: Return
24.description: First green shoots emerging from a winter compost bed inside a quiet glass temple, returning sunlight after solstice, one small lamp relit, circular pathways dusted with frost.

25.name: Innocence
25.description: Wild deer wandering into a solar orchard, untouched fruit, clear stream, young monk laughing with muddy hands, the scene unplanned and perfectly alive.

26.name: Great Taming
26.description: Enormous solar sails furled and held by braided hemp cables above a mountain reservoir, disciplined storage of immense light, stone guardians, controlled power waiting for the right season.

27.name: Nourishment
27.description: A communal kitchen greenhouse glowing at night, herbs suspended in hydroponic spirals, clay ovens, bowls of rice, rainwater tea, nourishment as sacred ecology.

28.name: Great Preponderance
28.description: An overloaded bamboo bridge bending under massive solar panels while workers brace it from below, beauty at the edge of collapse, huge responsibility in warm golden light.

29.name: The Abyss
29.description: A vertical water temple descending into a deep blue gorge, turbines humming in mist, narrow ladders, lanterns reflected in black water, danger as depth and repetition.

30.name: Radiance
30.description: Twin solar towers blazing at sunset, butterflies of reflected light moving across greenhouse glass, red flowers, copper mirrors, fire held in luminous harmony.

31.name: Influence
31.description: Two floating gardens slowly drawn together by invisible magnetic currents, ripples touching first, blossoms leaning toward each other, gentle attraction across water.

32.name: Duration
32.description: Ancient stone steps worn smooth beneath new solar vines, a waterwheel turning steadily, century-old trees supporting modern glass walkways, endurance as living maintenance.

33.name: Retreat
33.description: A hermit withdrawing into a high alpine greenhouse as storm clouds climb the valley, folding mirrors inward, closing shutters, retreat as strategic preservation.

34.name: Great Power
34.description: A field of sun towers at noon, giant golden panels roaring open, muscular clouds parting, workers tiny below, overwhelming clean force requiring restraint.

35.name: Progress
35.description: A solar tram ascending through stacked garden terraces toward a bright sky station, seedlings lining the rails, banners snapping, upward movement in gleaming green and gold.

36.name: Darkening of the Light
36.description: Hidden lantern gardens beneath blackout cloth during an eclipse, caretakers shielding delicate flames, bruised violet sky, wisdom kept alive underground.

37.name: The Family
37.description: A multigenerational household tending a courtyard aquaponic garden, grandparents mending copper pipes, children feeding fish, parents pruning vines, domestic order as living ecosystem.

38.name: Opposition
38.description: Two greenhouse towers facing opposite directions, one moonlit and blue, one sunlit and gold, separate water channels crossing without touching, difference held in elegant tension.

39.name: Obstruction
39.description: A landslide blocking a mountain aqueduct, fallen stones, broken mirror fragments, travelers halted before a foggy pass, the path requiring redirection not force.

40.name: Deliverance
40.description: Sudden rain bursting over a parched solar village, shutters thrown open, channels filling, people laughing under cascading water, release after pressure.

41.name: Decrease
41.description: A caretaker pruning a lush rooftop garden back to elegant essentials, cut vines becoming compost, fewer lamps, clearer light, subtraction as sacred offering.

42.name: Increase
42.description: Seed kites released from a solar tower, hundreds of glowing pods drifting into empty fields, rainbows through irrigation mist, generosity multiplying across the valley.

43.name: Breakthrough
43.description: A pressurized water wall bursting through an old cracked dam into new channels, sunlight exploding in spray, workers raising gates, decisive truth opening flow.

44.name: Coming to Meet
44.description: A strange luminous vine entering a pristine solar conservatory through an open window, beautiful and slightly dangerous, petals like tiny mirrors, a surprised gardener frozen mid-step.

45.name: Gathering Together
45.description: A great circular plaza where hill villages bring water, seeds, tools, lanterns, and stories, solar canopy overhead like a golden flower, convergence and ceremony.

46.name: Pushing Upward
46.description: Bamboo scaffolds spiraling around a young tree growing through an old tower, workers climbing with careful hands, small ascent repeated into greatness.

47.name: Oppression
47.description: A dry well beneath harsh noon panels, cracked clay, wilted lotus leaves, a tired mechanic sitting in shadow with one cup of water, pressure and exhaustion in a beautiful hard world.

48.name: The Well
48.description: A restored village well with transparent solar pumps, blue water glowing deep below, people lowering woven buckets, ancient source renewed by gentle technology.

49.name: Revolution
49.description: Old smoke stacks transformed into vertical gardens and sun chimneys, workers removing black metal panels while flowers burst through, revolution as ecological conversion.

50.name: The Cauldron
50.description: A huge bronze solar cauldron in a temple kitchen, sunlight focused into its belly, steam rising with herbs and stars, sacred transformation through cooking and craft.

51.name: The Arousing
51.description: Lightning striking a distant wind tower as temple bells leap into motion, startled birds, apprentices awake in blue-white flash, shock that awakens the valley.

52.name: Keeping Still
52.description: A meditation pod carved into a mountain garden, mirrors folded shut, water perfectly still, mossy stone, one seated figure before a wall of living roots, stillness as active containment.

53.name: Development
53.description: A migratory bird nesting on successive rooftop gardens up a mountain slope, each terrace more mature than the last, slow stages of greening civilization.

54.name: The Marrying Maiden
54.description: A young envoy arriving at a grand solar alliance ceremony, carrying a small grafted sapling into a palace greenhouse, beauty mixed with uncertain position.

55.name: Abundance
55.description: A midday harvest festival exploding with fruit, light, flowers, water wheels, gold mirrors, and full baskets, the sun at its zenith, joy so bright it almost overwhelms.

56.name: The Wanderer
56.description: A solitary traveler crossing floating solar lantern camps in a high desert of glassy stones, portable seed case at their side, temporary shelter under enormous stars.

57.name: The Gentle
57.description: Soft wind moving through bamboo turbines and hanging herb curtains, subtle currents turning many small wheels, invisible influence made visible in leaves and chimes.

58.name: Joy
58.description: Twin rooftop ponds sparkling with children, lotus drones, laughing elders, and reflected sun disks, joy as shared water and open sky.

59.name: Dispersion
59.description: Fog lifting from a valley as sun mirrors scatter gold beams through mist, old fears dissolving, boats separating seed bundles across canals.

60.name: Limitation
60.description: Elegant water clocks and calibrated sluice gates regulating a terraced garden, each drop measured, blue ceramic channels, beauty in boundaries.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.description: A transparent greenhouse heart chamber with a single glowing seed suspended in water, birds nesting in the rafters, quiet sincerity radiating outward.

62.name: Small Preponderance
62.description: Tiny maintenance drones repairing delicate solar petals high above a ravine, small winged machines against huge sky, careful humility in high places.

63.name: After Completion
63.description: A finished mountain water garden at dusk, every lamp lit, every channel flowing, caretakers doing final checks with quiet vigilance, completion that still requires attention.

64.name: Before Completion
64.description: An unfinished solar bridge glowing at dawn, last panels missing, foxlike shadows crossing scaffolds, tools arranged, workers not yet arrived, threshold energy before the final crossing.
